page.overview:
What is Tou-Chuka Island?

Tou-Chuka Island is a non-canon island known for its Chinese food ingredients, including many healthy foods and natural cures.

It acts as the setting of the Toriko x One Piece Collab Special 2 episode.

Tou-Chuka Island is entirely covered in dense forest, with a single mountain covering the center of the island. The base of the mountain is surrounded by large stone walls, and an ancient floodgate encircles the top of the mountain, with a seawater reservoir and a smaller island inside. A giant rests on one of the island's beaches, and giant bamboo shoots protrude from the opposite side of the island.

A monument outside an abandoned temple has the inscription "on the island, where the sea overflows, the fruit grows", hinting at the location of the Seafood Fruit.
